name: 1H-Indole-3-ethanamine, 5-nitro-
summary: 5-Nitrotryptamine, also known as Nitro-I, is a serotonin receptor modulator and psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. It is the 5-nitro derivative of tryptamine.

pharmacology.text: 5-Nitrotryptamine, also known as Nitro-I, is a serotonin receptor modulator and psychedelic drug of the tryptamine family. The drug is a biased agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor (Ki = 490–2,050 nM; EC50 = 0.11–491 nM; Emax = 44–108%). Unlike 5-phenoxytryptamine (OVT2), Nitro-I does not produce serotonin 5-HT2A receptor-mediated long-term memory deficits.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is used in research on how drugs switch on the 5-HT2A receptor.
uses.zh: 它被用於研究藥物如何活化5-HT2A受體。
uses.zhHans: 它被用于研究药物如何活化5-HT2A受体。

fact.en: It puts a nitro group, a nitrogen bonded to two oxygens, on the same ring position where serotonin carries its hydroxyl group.
fact.zh: 它在血清素帶有羥基的同一環位置上，放了一個硝基，也就是一個氮與兩個氧鍵結的基團。
fact.zhHans: 它在血清素带有羟基的同一环位置上，放了一个硝基，也就是一个氮与两个氧键结的基团。
